I am writing to express my interest in the Staff Engineer position at Ashgrove Systems. With six years of backend engineering experience at NorthWind Robotics, where I owned an order-routing service handling approximately 2 million events per day using TypeScript and Node.js on PostgreSQL, I have developed a strong foundation in building scalable systems. I also led a migration from a monolithic architecture to event-driven services, achieving zero customer-visible downtime and reducing p99 checkout latency from 1.9 seconds to 340 milliseconds.

During my two years as an engineering lead at Vertex Logistics, I managed a team of five engineers across dispatch and billing product lines. This experience sharpened my ability to guide technical direction while maintaining delivery velocity. I am proficient in Kubernetes and Terraform for service deployment, and I have deep expertise in PostgreSQL schema design, query tuning, and logical replication.

I am eager to bring this combination of hands-on engineering, system design, and leadership experience to Ashgrove Systems. I am confident that my background in event-driven architectures and operational excellence would enable me to contribute effectively to your engineering team. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can support Ashgrove Systems' goals.
